margin_top_mm.condition: Derived text-block top after accounting for includeheadfoot; original top parameter and header dimensions are recorded separately.

margin_bottom_mm.condition: Derived from nearest-whole-baseline text height, with 10 TeX pt top skip.

margin_left_mm.condition: Odd-page inner margin. Mirrored on even pages when inner and outer margins differ.

margin_right_mm.condition: Odd-page outer margin. Mirrored on even pages when inner and outer margins differ.

header_distance_mm.condition: Distance from the top paper edge to the top of the header box.

footer_distance_mm.condition: Distance from the bottom paper edge to the footer baseline after rounded text height.

height_rounding.value: nearest integral body baseline plus top skip

running_header_slots.condition: LE/RE are left/right even-page slots; LO/RO are left/right odd-page slots. Review line-number overlays are separate.

running_footer_alignment.condition: Journal publication metadata footer; the anonymous-review option does not authorize changing stored author text.

table_heavy_rule_width.condition: When booktabs rules are used in the manuscript table.

table_light_rule_width.condition: When booktabs rules are used in the manuscript table.

table_mid_rule_width.condition: When booktabs rules are used in the manuscript table.

table_above_rule_gap.condition: When booktabs rules are used in the manuscript table.

table_below_rule_gap.condition: When booktabs rules are used in the manuscript table.

space_before_pt.condition: Nominal display skip at body size. In manuscript mode setspace applies a further display-skip multiplier; short preceding lines use the short-display exception.

author_year_hanging_indent_em.condition: One em is evaluated when natbib loads, at the normal body font size, and remains a fixed dimension at bibliography rendering.
